tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm, not pure white, so cards read as surfaces on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the nav. Border with line-soft; no shadows.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Bars at rest, code, table group rows, muted chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the error-bar half of the mark. 15.7:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table headers. 7:1 on ground; never below 13px.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, axis labels, hints at 12px or larger only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, input borders, dividers between sections.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables and lists.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The accent and the check in the mark. Primary buttons, selected nav, links, the active half of a progress bar. Reserved for navigation and selection; never a status.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Link text and text on blue-tint. 10:1 on surface.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, pending-changes tray, agent message bubbles, confidence bands at 12% opacity.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: The verdict strip and triage banner: one dark band at the top of a page that states the conclusion. Text on it is slate-ink.

tokens.name: slate-ink
tokens.usage: Text on slate.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Pass, trusted, fixed, significant improvement. Always paired with a word; never the only signal.

tokens.name: good-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a good pill or a saved-field state.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Stale, flaky, below target, needs attention. Not an error.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a warn pill or banner.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Fail, broke, high severity, a conflict on save, a missing tool call. Also the Discard action.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a bad pill, a conflicted field, a failed step in a transcript.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a pill with no judgement attached: unknown, needs labels, low severity, counts.

tokens.name: planned
tokens.usage: Only in roadmap and comparison material, for what is designed but not shipped. Never in the product.

tokens.name: planned-tint
tokens.usage: Background for planned marks in roadmap material.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only, and the only use of Sora. Lowercase, tracked tight, test in blue.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page. A page named for a task, judge or failure mode sets it in mono at the same size.

styles.name: big-number
styles.usage: A suite pass rate or delta. Always followed by its margin in mono-small. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: verdict
styles.sample: Agent error. It found both charges and never called process_refund.
styles.usage: The sentence in the slate strip. Regular weight; only the two-word lead is 600. Identifiers inside it are mono at 14px.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Card and panel headings. Text family, not display.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above a group, and the speaker label on a transcript turn (CUSTOMER, AGENT, TOOL). ink-muted; bad when it flags a missing step.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Its reference solution also fails the outcome check, so the task or grader is wrong.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: tone_mismatch was edited after its test pass.
styles.usage: The lead clause of an alert or a table cell that carries the row.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Held-out test set · target TPR and TNR ≥ 90%
styles.usage: Under a heading or a chart. ink-muted. Never below 12px.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Status pills: 6px 10px padding, line-height 1, radius-pill, a tint ground and its ink. Always a word.

styles.name: guide-body
styles.sample: An eval is a test for an AI feature.
styles.usage: Long-form guides and memos, not the product.

styles.name: nav-item
styles.usage: Nav links. Ink at 500; the current page is 600 in blue-ink on blue-tint. Counts beside a nav item are mono-small on neutral-tint, number only.

styles.name: breadcrumb
styles.usage: Path above a page title. ink-muted, separators ink-faint, identifiers in mono at 12.5px.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: Anything that is a file, key, task id, failure mode or judge name. Weight 500 so it holds against 400 body text. If it exists on disk, it is mono.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Margins, timestamps, counts beside numbers. Use tabular numerals.

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: Tool calls, YAML, diffs. On surface-sunken with radius-md; a tool result on its own line in ink-muted; a failed or missing call on bad-tint. pre-wrap, never a horizontal scroll inside a transcript.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a pill and its neighbour; inside tight chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; gap inside a cell.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; row padding in tables.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop; between page header and content.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, link row, chip and nav item. Non-negotiable.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips inside tables, small swatches, kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, inline panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the verdict strip.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and failure-mode chips.
